## Phase

Which phase of `docs/PHASES.md` (specification §259) does this cover?

## Specification sections

List the sections of `docs/spec/01_MASTER_AI_SPECIFICATION.txt` this implements.

## The five required answers (§1)

- **What is it?**
- **How does it work?**
- **How do I operate it?**
- **How does it affect the survey?**
- **How do I prove the result is trustworthy?**

A subject is incomplete until all five are represented.

## Engine work

What pure calculation is needed, and what will the tests assert?

## Limitations

What will this deliberately not model, and where will that be documented?

## Checklist

- [ ] Existing code inspected for reusable components
- [ ] Engine implemented and tested
- [ ] UI layer added
- [ ] Simulated output labelled
- [ ] `docs/PHASES.md` and `src/data/knowledge-graph.ts` updated
- [ ] `docs/LIMITATIONS.md` updated
- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass
